item.title: How to generate a component in Angular
item.description: Generating components efficiently is fundamental for building scalable Angular applications with consistent structure and proper organization. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve generated thousands of Angular components for enterprise dashboards, admin panels, and complex business applications. From my expertise, the most reliable approach is to use Angular CLI’s ng generate component command. This method ensures proper file structure, imports, and module declarations while following Angular best practices automatically.
